# iXBRL fixtures

Real filings from the Companies House free Accounts Data Product
(`Accounts_Bulk_Data-2026-09-02.zip`, download.companieshouse.gov.uk), public data,
unmodified. Chosen to cover: the 2008 and 2013 inline XBRL namespaces, the `core`,
`frs-core` and opaque `nsN` taxonomy prefixes, and the `numcommadot`, `numdotdecimal`,
`numdash` and `zerodash` number formats with `scale` and `sign` attributes.
